sections.markdown:
## C2 — Permit, test and training confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A07
The knowledge test counts twenty five questions but only twenty correct answers, so the length and the pass mark are two different numbers to keep apart. [A07]
Why it matters: group_hint test-format; prereq_hint sec01-F17; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F17, sec01-F20.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]
FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A08
School trained applicants wait one hundred twenty days for the road test while all others wait one hundred eighty days, and the shorter wait belongs only to the school path. [A08]
Why it matters: group_hint wait-periods; prereq_hint sec01-F28; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F31, sec01-F36.
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]
FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A08
Thirty classroom hours pair with forty coached road hours for school teens, while home teens log thirty study hours plus forty road hours, and neither mix matches the thirty plus eight shortcut to the shorter wait. [A08]
Why it matters: group_hint hour-totals; prereq_hint sec01-F28; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F30, sec01-F33, sec01-F36.
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]
FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A08
Form CS-1 certifies school course completion for road test eligibility, whereas form CS-1a certifies the home trainer’s eight hour alcohol syllabus course, and the two forms are not interchangeable. [A08]
Why it matters: group_hint certificates; prereq_hint sec01-F30; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec01-F30, sec01-F34.
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]
FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A06
The eight hour Safe Driving Practices class binds every first time applicant of any age, while the two hour parent teaching block binds only teen permit families. [A06]
Why it matters: group_hint course-scope; prereq_hint sec01-F12; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F12, sec01-F29.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]
FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A08
A twenty plus adult with four suspension free licensed years may instruct a teen permit holder, but that same adult counts as the single allowed passenger only while actively instructing. [A08]
Why it matters: group_hint instructor-vs-passenger; prereq_hint sec01-F25; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F25, sec01-F32.
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]
FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A07
Vision screening and the knowledge test are separate permit gates: one checks eyesight minimums and the other checks manual knowledge, and both must be passed. [A07]
Why it matters: group_hint permit-gates; prereq_hint sec01-F17; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec01-F17, sec01-F21.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]
FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A07
A permit ends at licensing or at two years from issue, so an early license beats the calendar and a slow learner faces expiry. [A07]
Why it matters: group_hint permit-validity; prereq_hint sec01-F16; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec01-F16, sec01-F18.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]
FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A06
This manual and its Class D license cover passenger vehicles only, while truck and bus drivers study the Commercial Driver License manual and riders study the Motorcycle Operator manual. [A06]
Why it matters: group_hint manual-scope; prereq_hint sec01-F01; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec01-F01, sec01-F02.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0006]
FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A07
Standard applicants meet 20/40 vision in general, but one eyed applicants must show 20/40 plus a one hundred degree field in the remaining eye. [A07]
Why it matters: group_hint vision-tiers; prereq_hint sec01-F21; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec01-F21, sec01-F22.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0007]
